newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL-Tyco surges on Mattel deal.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL-Tyco surges on Mattel deal.

text.p: Shares in Tyco Toys Inc jumped more than 50 percent in Monday's U.S. pre-opening activity after news the company would be acquired by Mattel Inc in a stock deal valued at $755 million.
Tyco shares rose 4-5/8 to 11-5/8. Shares in Mattel, which will swap shares worth $12.50 for each Tyco share, were offered at 30-5/8, in line with their closing price on Friday.
"I would think (Tyco) shares would continue to trade somewhere around here because this is a stock deal, not a cash deal," one trader said.

In other activity, Boeing Co was bid higher at 92-1/4 after the company emerged as one of two finalists in the competition to supply the next generation of U.S. fighter jets. Shares closed at 91-3/4 on Friday.
Shares in Lockheed Martin Corp, the other finalist, were untraded, as were shares in McDonnell Douglas Corp, which was dropped from the running for the Joint Strike Fighter project.
